decisions.statement: Which mechanical change fits is read from the property the key names.
A key naming a relation is handed to the mechanical change for a relation.
Every other key is handed to the mechanical change stating one key anew.
A path the world names no page at is refused.
The value under the key is stated anew whole rather than a passage of it.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
A key with many values is refused here.
The refusal for many values names the changes putting a value in and taking a value out.

definition: the whole value of one property of one page stated anew, by the mechanical change fitting it
